measurement_protocol.range_note: Test-control proposals, not manufacturer safety limits. Charge-rate trials need a separate fixed comparable SOC window; freeze exact conditions before measuring.
measurement_protocol.insufficient_data: Missing/unsupported telemetry, lost traces, unverified units, unequal workloads or inadequate precision yield blocked/inconclusive, never zero or pass.
measurement_protocol.threshold_rule: The throughput, latency and energy completion target is stock parity at ratio 1.0; there is no default 5-percent throughput loss or 10-percent latency/energy increase allowance. Measurement methods are proposals until the controlled Android baseline establishes effective precision. Freeze metric, uncertainty/decision rule and timestamp before Linux trials; unresolved evidence remains inconclusive and no target may be relaxed after seeing a failing Linux result. No value is an observed performance or hardware-pass claim.

paired-throughput.rule: Stock parity target: Linux throughput is not below Android, ratio >= 1.0. Use identical workload/data/app version, hardware path and thermal/power conditions. After the controlled Android baseline, freeze effective precision and the uncertainty/confidence decision method before Linux trials; uncertainty is not a default performance discount. Unresolved parity or inadequate precision is inconclusive.

paired-latency.rule: Stock parity target: Linux p95 latency is not above Android p95, ratio <= 1.0. Use the same input/display/network method and sampling. After the controlled Android baseline, freeze timing uncertainty, effective precision and the decision rule before Linux trials. If Android is zero or below resolution, predefine an equivalent absolute parity bound; unresolved evidence is inconclusive, not an allowed regression.

paired-energy.rule: Stock parity target: Linux energy for the same work/interval is not above Android, ratio <= 1.0. Use the same battery, SOC window, measured luminance, refresh, radios and workload. Require a calibrated energy source/counter and freeze effective precision, uncertainty and the decision method after the Android baseline but before Linux trials. Unvalidated charge_counter, percent-only short samples or USB input watts cannot substitute for battery energy; insufficient evidence is inconclusive.

paired-quality.rule: Freeze the actual metric and tolerance after Android baseline: position error/jitter, color/luminance, audio noise/distortion, camera frame quality, or sensor bias/orientation. No metric or instrument means blocked, not zero error.

active-refresh.rule: For each verified Android-supported mode use current DRM timing plus independent cadence observation. Advertised mode names or generic tracepoint counts alone cannot establish active refresh.
